purpose: H70 exact producer contract handoff under H123 generic RawFrame/RawTypedScope additive scope only

declarations.name: materialize_view
declarations.signature:
theorem materialize_view {ctx} (state : State ctx) :
    localWordCells ctx (materialize state).1 = view state

declarations.name: projection
declarations.signature:
theorem projection {ctx control} (code : Stmt [] (localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
    (policy : Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat) (state : State ctx) :
    (run code policy fuel state).map Outcome.project =
      WordAdapter.run code policy fuel ⟨Fin.elim0, view state⟩

declarations.name: local_projection
declarations.signature:
theorem local_projection {ctx control} (code : Stmt [] (localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
    (policy : Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat) (state : State ctx) :
    (run code policy fuel state).map Outcome.project =
      (runLocalBlock ctx code policy fuel (materialize state)).map LocalBlockOutcome.project

declarations.name: preserves
declarations.signature:
theorem preserves {ctx control} (code : Stmt [] (localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
    (policy : Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat) (state : State ctx) {result}
    (done : run code policy fuel state = some result) :
    result.state.clean = state.clean ∧ result.state.world = state.world

declarations.name: run_snapshot
declarations.signature:
theorem run_snapshot : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (control : Solidity.Yul.Control)
 (code : Solidity.Yul.Stmt [] (Solidity.Yul.localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
 (policy : Solidity.Yul.Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State ctx),
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.run code policy fuel
 (Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.capture state (Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.view state)) =
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.run code policy fuel state

declarations.name: run_agrees
declarations.signature:
theorem run_agrees : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (control : Solidity.Yul.Control)
 (code : Solidity.Yul.Stmt [] (Solidity.Yul.localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
 (policy : Solidity.Yul.Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat)
 (first second : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State ctx),
 first.clean = second.clean → first.world = second.world →
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.view first = Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.view second →
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.run code policy fuel first = Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.run code policy fuel second

declarations.name: run_captured
declarations.signature:
theorem run_captured : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (control : Solidity.Yul.Control)
 (code : Solidity.Yul.Stmt [] (Solidity.Yul.localExternalTypes ctx) control 0)
 (policy : Solidity.Yul.Policy.StmtP .A code) (fuel : Nat)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State ctx) (result : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.Outcome ctx control),
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.run code policy fuel state = some result →
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.capture result.state (Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.view result.state) = result.state

declarations.name: coherent_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem coherent_iff {ctx} (state : RawFrame.State ctx) :
    coherent state = true ↔
      RawFrame.view state = localWordCells ctx (LocalValues.ofClean state.clean)

declarations.name: prepare_coherent
declarations.signature:
theorem prepare_coherent {ctx} (state : RawFrame.State ctx) (same : coherent state = true) :
    prepare state = LocalState.ofClean (state.clean, state.world)

declarations.name: invariant
declarations.signature:
theorem invariant {ctx returns modifier control stmt}
    (proof : RawSource.Supported ctx returns modifier control stmt)
    (glob : Solidity.Source.Glob ctx.env) (frame : Solidity.Source.Fr)
    (fuel : Nat) (state : RawFrame.State ctx) (same : coherent state = true) :
    coherent (execS proof fuel state).2 = true

declarations.name: source_agrees
declarations.signature:
theorem source_agrees {ctx returns modifier control stmt}
    (proof : RawSource.Supported ctx returns modifier control stmt)
    (glob : Solidity.Source.Glob ctx.env) (frame : Solidity.Source.Fr)
    (fuel nps : Nat) (ph : Option (Solidity.Source.Ph ctx.env))
    (state : RawFrame.State ctx) (same : coherent state = true) :
    observe (execS proof fuel state) =
      some ((Solidity.Source.execS glob frame fuel nps ph stmt state.clean).run
        (Solidity.Source.L0 ctx.env, state.world))

declarations.name: source_run
declarations.signature:
theorem source_run {ctx returns modifier control stmt}
    (proof : RawSource.Supported ctx returns modifier control stmt)
    (glob : Solidity.Source.Glob ctx.env) (frame : Solidity.Source.Fr)
    (fuel nps : Nat) (ph : Option (Solidity.Source.Ph ctx.env))
    (state : RawFrame.State ctx) (same : coherent state = true) :
    (Solidity.Source.execS glob frame fuel nps ph stmt state.clean).run
      (Solidity.Source.L0 ctx.env, state.world) =
        ((execS proof fuel state).1.map (fun _ => .normal (execS proof fuel state).2.clean),
          (Solidity.Source.L0 ctx.env, (execS proof fuel state).2.world))

declarations.name: drop_coherent
declarations.signature:
theorem drop_coherent : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)),
 Solidity.Yul.RawCoherent.coherent state = true →
 Solidity.Yul.RawCoherent.coherent (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.drop state) = true

declarations.name: project_close
declarations.signature:
theorem project_close :
 ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (result : Solidity.Source.R Solidity.Yul.RawLoopBody.Flow × Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)),
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.project result =
 Solidity.Yul.RawLoopBody.represented (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result)

declarations.name: close_correct
declarations.signature:
theorem close_correct : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (result : Solidity.Source.R Solidity.Yul.RawLoopBody.Flow × Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)),
 Solidity.Yul.RawCoherent.coherent result.2 = true →
 Solidity.Yul.RawCoherent.coherent (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result).2 = true ∧
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.project result = Solidity.Yul.RawLoopBody.represented (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result)

declarations.name: drop_scalar_read
declarations.signature:
theorem drop_scalar_read : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)) (cell : Solidity.Yul.SourceScalarCell ctx),
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.scalarRead (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.drop state) cell =
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.scalarRead state (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.liftScalar name ty cell)

declarations.name: drop_function_read
declarations.signature:
theorem drop_function_read : ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)) (cell : Solidity.Yul.SourceFunctionCell ctx),
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.functionRead (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.drop state) cell =
 Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.functionRead state (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.liftFunction name ty cell)

declarations.name: drop_clean
declarations.signature:
theorem drop_clean :
 ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)), (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.drop state).clean = state.clean.drop 1

declarations.name: drop_world
declarations.signature:
theorem drop_world :
 ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (state : Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)), (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.drop state).world = state.world

declarations.name: close_captured
declarations.signature:
theorem close_captured :
 ∀ (ctx : Solidity.Source.Ctx) (name : String) (ty : Solidity.Source.STy)
 (result : Solidity.Source.R Solidity.Yul.RawLoopBody.Flow × Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.State (ctx.push name ty)),
 Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.capture (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result).2
   (Solidity.Yul.RawFrame.view (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result).2) =
 (Solidity.Yul.RawTypedScope.close result).2

premises_and_limits: RawFrame.run/projection/local_projection/preserves cover existing pure Tier-A policy-certified Yul statements over logical locals, not physical layout or memory/world-changing operations.
RawFrame.preserves and run_captured retain actual completed-run premises. Optional raw overlays are not a write set.

RawCoherent.invariant/source_agrees/source_run retain RawSource.Supported and coherent state = true. RawSource.Supported is the existing certified bool-control expression-statement slice; not arbitrary Source admission.
Coherence means full authoritative word-view equality with the clean backup, not successful dirty readback or cleanup on write.

RawTypedScope.drop_coherent/close_correct retain coherence premises. project_close, metadata preservation and scalar/function projection are generic additive laws over existing typed scope operations.
No H58 representation rewrite, new state carrier, physical adapter completeness, general Source/copy integration, budget change or trust waiver is delivered.
Consumer must instantiate exact signatures and retain all premises; send the exact remaining adapter obligation if this API does not discharge it.
